verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Pods can be connected via SSH, JupyterLab, or VS Code/Cursor for local IDE integration, and templates pre-configure PyTorch/JupyterLab so everything is 'ready instantly' without manual setup. Community evidence corroborates ease of use (template-based one-click deploys) though notes the execution environment is 'locked down,' a minor friction point for advanced tooling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the actual one-step VS Code/Cursor connect experience beyond vendor docs.
